rules: Source Design Cases stay canonical in Matbagy-OS; this file stores extracted recipe candidates only.
FINAL_APPROVED or EXPLICITLY_LIKED cases are stronger recipe evidence than SAVED/NOT_CONFIRMED cases.
Archival final is not customer approval.
Rejected/superseded outputs are negative learning, not positive templates.
Identity/face preservation is a hard constraint when explicitly requested.
Exact logos and explicit text must be reused from source assets/data, not hallucinated.

candidates.notes: Remove full name line when requested; remove subject background; place cutout on specified side; support separate outputs.
Remove editor/panel residue; use exact uploaded logo; no extra invented label text.
Replace only requested portrait/photo while preserving other composition/text unless explicitly changed.
20x9 horizontal canvas; two photos side placement; text centered; preserve original identities.
Merge person into existing event composition; if correction is local, change only targeted region; case is final-approved.
Newspaper-style graduation layout with explicit headline/text/photo mapping; exact wording/placement constraints dominate stylistic inference.
Explicit clean-white/background-removal request overrides decorative carryover; negative learning should remove unwanted decoration.
20x9 romantic layout; photo/text side separation; soft decoration only if not overridden.
Extract/prepare artwork itself rather than recreating product mockup. Source case requires revision, so use as negative/constraint evidence until approved case exists.
Specialized generative reference task; not standard print workflow; requires identity-consistency checks.
15x21 kids bride/groom composition; final-approved; explicit clean-white correction becomes reusable negative-learning rule.
Extract package/reference front; replace person image; insert exact required phrase; 7x10.
Use outpainting/composition extension rather than re-generating the person; no facial change.
